description: List what this server changed in Canvas, newest first: when, which tool, the course and item IDs, whether it went through (done, failed, cancelled or refused) and how it was confirmed. Read-only, makes no Canvas calls and works before a token is set. Use it for "what did you change in my Canvas?" It keeps IDs only, never message text. CANVAS_CHANGE_LOG=off turns recording off.

limit.description: How many changes to show, newest first, 1 to 200. Default 25.

name: get_change_log
title: Get Change Log
